verses.original: כָּל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה עָשָׂ֥ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑הס וַתִּשְׁלַם֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ וַיָּבֵ֨א אָבִ֗יו וְאֶת־ דָּוִ֣יד קָדְשֵׁ֣י׀ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְאֶת־ הַזָּהָב֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַכֵּלִ֔ים נָתַ֕ן בְּאֹצְר֖וֹת בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ham·mə·lā·ḵāh ’ă·šer- šə·lō·mōh ‘ā·śāh lə·ḇêṯ yə·h·wå̄·hs wat·tiš·lam šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- way·yā·ḇê ’ā·ḇîw wə·’eṯ- dā·wîḏ qā·ḏə·šê hak·ke·sep̄ wə·’eṯ- haz·zā·hāḇ wə·’eṯ- kāl- hak·kê·lîm nā·ṯan bə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: So all the work that Solomon had performed for the house of the LORD was completed Then Solomon - brought in {the items} his father - David had dedicated the silver - the gold - and all the furnishings and he placed them in the treasuries of the house of God

verses.original: אָז֩ שְׁלֹמֹ֜ה אֶת־ יַקְהֵ֨יל אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הַמַּטּ֜וֹת רָאשֵׁ֨י הָאָב֛וֹת נְשִׂיאֵ֧י לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְֽהַעֲל֞וֹת אֲר֧וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ הִ֥יא צִיּֽוֹן׃ מֵעִ֥יר דָּוִ֖יד
verses.transliteration: ’āz šə·lō·mōh ’eṯ- yaq·hêl ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl wə·’eṯ- kāl- ham·maṭ·ṭō·wṯ rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ nə·śî·’ê liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl lə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- hî ṣî·yō·wn mê·‘îr dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: At that time Solomon - assembled in Jerusalem the elders of Israel - all the tribal heads and family leaders . . . vvv of the Israelites to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD - - from Zion the City of David

verses.original: כָּל־ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיִּקָּהֲל֧וּ הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶל־ בֶּחָ֑ג ה֖וּא הַשְּׁבִעִֽי׃ הַחֹ֥דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’îš yiś·rā·’êl way·yiq·qā·hă·lū ham·me·leḵ ’el- be·ḥāḡ hū haš·šə·ḇi·‘î ha·ḥō·ḏeš
verses.literal: So all the men of Israel came together to the king - at the feast in the seventh month

verses.original: כֹּ֖ל זִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּבֹ֕אוּ הַלְוִיִּ֖ם אֶת־ וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ הָאָרֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: kōl ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·ḇō·’ū hal·wî·yim ’eṯ- way·yiś·’ū hā·’ā·rō·wn
verses.literal: When all the elders of Israel had arrived the Levites - took up the ark

verses.original: וַיַּעֲל֤וּ אֶת־ הָאָרוֹן֙ וְאֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּאֹ֑הֶל הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ כְּלֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃ הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הֶעֱל֣וּ אֹתָ֔ם
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·lū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·rō·wn wə·’eṯ- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer bā·’ō·hel haq·qō·ḏeš kə·lê hal·wî·yim hak·kō·hă·nîm he·‘ĕ·lū ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: and they brought up - the ark and the Tent of Meeting with all - [its] sacred furnishings The Levitical priests carried them up -

verses.original: לִפְנֵ֣י הָאָר֑וֹן וְהַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֗ה וְכָל־ עֲדַ֧ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הַנּוֹעָדִ֥ים עָלָ֖יו מְזַבְּחִים֙ מֵרֹֽב׃ צֹ֣אן וּבָקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יִסָּפְר֛וּ וְלֹ֥א יִמָּנ֖וּ
verses.transliteration: lip̄·nê hā·’ā·rō·wn wə·ham·me·leḵ šə·lō·mōh wə·ḵāl ‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl han·nō·w·‘ā·ḏîm ‘ā·lāw mə·zab·bə·ḥîm mê·rōḇ ṣōn ū·ḇā·qār ’ă·šer lō- yis·sā·p̄ə·rū wə·lō yim·mā·nū
verses.literal: There, before the ark King Solomon and the whole congregation of Israel who had assembled with him sacrificed so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted . . . or numbered

verses.original: הַ֠כֹּהֲנִים אֶת־ וַיָּבִ֣יאוּ אֲר֨וֹן בְּרִית־ יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־ מְקוֹמ֛וֹ אֶל־ דְּבִ֥יר הַבַּ֖יִת אֶל־ קֹ֣דֶשׁ הַקְּדָשִׁ֑ים אֶל־ תַּ֖חַת כַּנְפֵ֥י הַכְּרוּבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm ’eṯ- way·yā·ḇî·’ū ’ă·rō·wn bə·rîṯ- Yah·weh ’el- mə·qō·w·mōw ’el- də·ḇîr hab·ba·yiṯ ’el- qō·ḏeš haq·qə·ḏā·šîm ’el- ta·ḥaṯ kan·p̄ê hak·kə·rū·ḇîm
verses.literal: Then the priests - brought the ark of the covenant of the LORD to its place in the inner sanctuary of the temple - the Most Holy Place . . . . . . beneath the wings of the cherubim

verses.original: וַיִּהְי֤וּ הַכְּרוּבִים֙ פֹּרְשִׂ֣ים כְּנָפַ֔יִם עַל־ מְק֖וֹם הָאָר֑וֹן הַכְּרוּבִ֛ים עַל־ וַיְכַסּ֧וּ מִלְמָֽעְלָה׃ הָאָר֥וֹן וְעַל־ בַּדָּ֖יו
verses.transliteration: way·yih·yū hak·kə·rū·ḇîm pō·rə·śîm kə·nā·p̄a·yim ‘al- mə·qō·wm hā·’ā·rō·wn hak·kə·rū·ḇîm ‘al- way·ḵas·sū mil·mā·‘ə·lāh hā·’ā·rō·wn wə·‘al- bad·dāw
verses.literal: For the cherubim spread their wings over the place of the ark - and overshadowed . . . the ark and its poles

verses.original: הַבַּדִּים֒ מִן־ הָאָרוֹן֙ וַֽיַּאֲרִיכוּ֮ הַבַּדִּ֤ים רָאשֵׁ֨י וַיֵּרָאוּ֩ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַדְּבִ֔יר וְלֹ֥א יֵרָא֖וּ הַח֑וּצָה וַֽיְהִי־ שָׁ֔ם עַ֖ד הַזֶּֽה׃ הַיּ֥וֹם
verses.transliteration: hab·bad·dîm min- hā·’ā·rō·wn way·ya·’ă·rî·ḵū hab·bad·dîm rā·šê way·yê·rā·’ū ‘al- pə·nê had·də·ḇîr wə·lō yê·rā·’ū ha·ḥū·ṣāh way·hî- šām ‘aḏ haz·zeh hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: The poles of the ark extended far enough that their ends were visible from in front of the inner sanctuary but not - from outside [the Holy Place] and they are there to this day

verses.original: אֵ֚ין בָּֽאָר֔וֹן רַ֚ק שְׁנֵ֣י הַלֻּח֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה נָתַ֥ן בְּחֹרֵ֑ב אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְהוָה֙ כָּרַ֤ת עִם־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ên bā·’ā·rō·wn raq šə·nê hal·lu·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer- mō·šeh nā·ṯan bə·ḥō·rêḇ ’ă·šer Yah·weh kā·raṯ ‘im- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl bə·ṣê·ṯām mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: [There was] nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses had placed in it at Horeb where the LORD had made a covenant with the Israelites . . . after they had come out of Egypt

verses.original: כִּ֠י כָּל־ הַכֹּהֲנִ֤ים הַֽנִּמְצְאִים֙ הִתְקַדָּ֔שׁוּ אֵ֖ין לִשְׁמ֥וֹר לְמַחְלְקֽוֹת׃ וַיְהִ֕י הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּצֵ֥את מִן־ הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: kî kāl- hak·kō·hă·nîm han·nim·ṣə·’îm hiṯ·qad·dā·šū ’ên liš·mō·wr lə·maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ way·hî hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·ṣêṯ min- haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: Now all the priests who were present had consecrated themselves regardless of . . . their divisions And when the priests came out of the Holy Place

verses.original: לְכֻלָּ֡ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֣ם הַמְשֹׁרֲרִ֣ים לְאָסָ֡ף לְהֵימָ֣ן לִֽ֠ידֻתוּן וְלִבְנֵיהֶ֨ם וְלַאֲחֵיהֶ֜ם עֹמְדִ֖ים מִזְרָ֣ח לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ מְלֻבָּשִׁ֣ים בּ֗וּץ בִּמְצִלְתַּ֙יִם֙ וּבִנְבָלִ֣ים וְכִנֹּר֔וֹת וְעִמָּהֶ֤ם לְמֵאָ֣ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֔ים כֹּֽהֲנִים֙ מַחְצְרִרִים בַּחֲצֹֽצְרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḵul·lām wə·hal·wî·yim ham·šō·ră·rîm lə·’ā·sāp̄ lə·hê·mān lî·ḏu·ṯūn wə·liḇ·nê·hem wə·la·’ă·ḥê·hem ‘ō·mə·ḏîm miz·rāḥ lam·miz·bê·aḥ mə·lub·bā·šîm būṣ bim·ṣil·ta·yim ū·ḇin·ḇā·lîm wə·ḵin·nō·rō·wṯ wə·‘im·mā·hem lə·mê·’āh wə·‘eś·rîm kō·hă·nîm maḥ·ṣə·ri·rīm ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: all the Levitical singers Asaph Heman Jeduthun and their sons and relatives stood on the east side of the altar dressed in fine linen and playing cymbals harps and lyres accompanied by 120 . . . priests sounding trumpets

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י לַמַּחֲצֹצְרִים וְלַמְשֹֽׁרֲרִ֜ים לְהַשְׁמִ֣יעַ כְ֠אֶחָד לְהַלֵּ֣ל וּלְהֹדוֹת֮ לַיהוָה֒ אֶחָ֗ד קוֹל־ וּכְהָרִ֣ים ק֠וֹל בַּחֲצֹצְר֨וֹת וּבִמְצִלְתַּ֜יִם הַשִּׁ֗יר וּבִכְלֵ֣י וּבְהַלֵּ֤ל לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י חַסְדּ֑וֹ לְעוֹלָ֖ם וְהַבַּ֛יִת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃ מָלֵ֥א עָנָ֖ן
verses.transliteration: way·hî lam·ma·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rīm wə·lam·šō·ră·rîm lə·haš·mî·a‘ ḵə·’e·ḥāḏ lə·hal·lêl ū·lə·hō·ḏō·wṯ Yah·weh ’e·ḥāḏ qō·wl- ū·ḵə·hā·rîm qō·wl ba·ḥă·ṣō·ṣə·rō·wṯ ū·ḇim·ṣil·ta·yim haš·šîr ū·ḇiḵ·lê ū·ḇə·hal·lêl Yah·weh kî ṭō·wḇ kî ḥas·dōw lə·‘ō·w·lām wə·hab·ba·yiṯ bêṯ Yah·weh mā·lê ‘ā·nān
verses.literal: - The trumpeters and singers . . . joined together to praise and thank the LORD with one voice They lifted up their voices accompanied by trumpets cymbals and musical instruments in praise to the LORD For He is good . . . His loving devotion endures forever . . . And the temple the house of the LORD was filled with a cloud

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים וְלֹא־ יָֽכְל֧וּ לַעֲמ֥וֹד לְשָׁרֵ֖ת מִפְּנֵ֣י הֶעָנָ֑ן כִּֽי־ כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מָלֵ֥א בֵּ֥ית הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm wə·lō- yā·ḵə·lū la·‘ă·mō·wḏ lə·šā·rêṯ mip·pə·nê he·‘ā·nān kî- ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- mā·lê bêṯ hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: so that the priests could not stand there to minister because of the cloud For the glory of the LORD - filled the house of God
